title: Universe screen diagnostic seven-row repair authorization (v0.1, diagnostic measurement only)
description: One separately granted permission for one seven-row diagnostic repair measurement (ADR-115). It is a third authorization contract, distinct from both the authoritative live authorization and the 100-row diagnostic-canary authorization: each pins its own contract const, so no runner can consume another runner's grant. A repair run re-screens exactly the seven quote-resolution rejections of one completed, hash-bound source diagnostic run under the committed v5 diagnostic prompt. Everything the diagnostic authorization binds is bound here identically - packet cohort, prompt bytes, provider client contract, enablement, endpoints, model route, policies and budgets - and the selection binding points at a universe_screen_diagnostic_repair_selection artifact whose seven rows were derived relationally from the source run's records, never typed by hand. The canary arithmetic is schema-pinned to the seven-row shape: exactly 7 logical requests, 21 provider attempts and 28 external requests. max_rejected_rows is a bounded circuit breaker sized to a seven-row measurement: at least 1 and at most 7, and the runner additionally refuses a breaker that could never trip. A run authorized here is diagnostic_only and never promotable; its outputs carry repair-specific filenames and contracts that the SCREEN_v1, classifier, authoritative and standard diagnostic loaders all refuse structurally.

packet_manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact v0.5 packet manifest bytes this authorization covers. Verified at preflight against the manifest actually loaded and against the selection artifact's own binding.

prompt_template_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact committed prompts/discovery/universe_high_recall_screen.md bytes. Verified at preflight against the current committed bytes, before run-directory creation, SDK factory, ADC resolution, or any network; recorded again in the v0.2 screen manifest.

selection_kind.description: Pinned: a repair run screens exactly one repair_7 selection derived from one completed source diagnostic run.

provider_client_contract_sha256.description: The canonical client-contract digest, recomputed at preflight from the connector's own declared contract for the authorized project and location. Must equal the enablement's value.

logical_request_cap.description: One logical request per repaired row, exactly.

run_kind.description: The only permitted value; the 100-row canary and the authoritative screen are authorized by different contracts entirely.

max_rejected_rows.description: Circuit breaker sized to a seven-row measurement: exceeding it hard-stops the run with a governed receipt. Bounded to [1, 7]; the runner refuses a breaker equal to the row count as one that can never trip is not a breaker.
